claims.text: Jev Browser Use delegates navigation, clicks, toggles and scrolling while Codex handles text entry and final verification.

evidence.quote:
**Jev clicks. Codex thinks and verifies.**

A browser Skill powered by [TypeSafe’s Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction). Hand off navigation, clicks, toggles, and scrolling; keep Codex in charge of text input, visual judgment, and the final check.

claims.text: Jev selects actions from observed controls using accessibility text; the existing Computer Use connection executes them.

evidence.quote:
Jev handles the controls. Codex enters text, handles images, and checks the outcome. When a step needs help, Codex takes over and Jev resumes afterward.

## How it works

![Codex plans, types, and verifies; Jev clicks, navigates, and scrolls](assets/teamwork.png)

**Goal → observe controls → Jev chooses an action → browser → repeat → Codex verifies.**

The action loop stays inside the existing Computer Use connection, avoiding a new host-model turn for every click. Sessions retain progress across handoffs and check fresh page state before acting. Jev’s completion signal brings Codex back for verification.

Jev receives accessibility text, not screenshots. Codex handles typing, visual interpretation, and unsupported controls. Use it for dashboards, settings, reports, and browser checks—not just writing tasks.

claims.text: Requires Node.js 22+, a connected Codex browser and matching TypeSafe or OpenRouter credentials.

evidence.quote:
Choose the provider that issued your API key. A TypeSafe key goes with `provider: "typesafe"` and `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`; an OpenRouter key goes with `provider: "openrouter"` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. These keys are not interchangeable, even though both providers offer Jev. Put the key in the dotenv file named by `envFile` in `~/.config/jev-browser-use/config.json`.

You need **Node.js 22+**, **Codex with Computer Use connected to Chrome or its in-app browser**, and **Jev access through TypeSafe or OpenRouter Decisions**. Installing this Skill does not install the browser connection.

claims.text: Installing the skill does not provide browser access. Claude Code execution is not yet supported, and Jev receives no screenshots.

it.title: Jev Browser Use: delegare i controlli del browser da Codex
it.h1: Jev Browser Use: delegare i controlli del browser da Codex
it.description: Jev Browser Use delega clic, navigazione e scorrimento tramite il browser Codex; testo, valutazione visiva e verifica finale restano a Codex.
it.summary: Jev Browser Use gestisce navigazione, clic, interruttori e scorrimento; Codex inserisce testo e verifica il risultato. Jev sceglie azioni dal testo di accessibilità; la connessione Computer Use esistente le esegue. Servono Node.js 22+, Codex collegato al browser e credenziali corrispondenti TypeSafe o OpenRouter.

sections.heading: A cosa serve
sections.text: Jev Browser Use gestisce navigazione, clic, interruttori e scorrimento; Codex inserisce testo e verifica il risultato.

sections.text: Jev sceglie azioni dal testo di accessibilità; la connessione Computer Use esistente le esegue.

sections.heading: Come usarlo
sections.text: Servono Node.js 22+, Codex collegato al browser e credenziali corrispondenti TypeSafe o OpenRouter.

sections.heading: Limiti
sections.text: Installare l’abilità non fornisce la connessione browser. L’esecuzione con Claude Code non è ancora supportata e Jev non riceve screenshot.
